tool_args.rationale: The fitted archived ODE fails fresh confirmation by a wide margin. Given reported history-gap and transient-lag signatures and the unresolved sign of the archived source branch term, buy the lower-cost open-branch discriminating probe before selecting another model or abstaining.

considered_alternatives.option: Revise the coupled-memory ODE or use another stationary smooth model
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: The fresh confirmation decisively refuted the fitted four-parameter ODE (RMSE 1.162 versus 0.045 tolerance); the available evidence does not identify which alternative mechanism or open branch is correct.
Refutation alone does not establish non-stationarity or high-frequency chaotic oscillation; an open-branch discriminating probe can test the archived branch ambiguity first.
The failure occurred at H=0.6, so resolving the open branch is more directly informative than extending the horizon.
